description:
Add another person who can receive reminder calls, e.g. an elderly parent.

    ReminderIt immediately places a consent verification call to the number; reminders
    are only delivered after that person accepts. Only add someone the user genuinely
    has permission to call, and confirm the number digit by digit before submitting —
    a typo calls a stranger.

    Args:
        name: The person's name, used in the call greeting.
        phone: Their number in full E.164 format, e.g. "+447700900123".
        relationship: Optional label for the user's own reference, e.g. "Mother".
name: add_recipient
title: Add a person to remind
